subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK enforce a fixed 16 MiB body and 30-second upload envelope, and should the shared plugin-SDK body reader expose caller-controlled socket teardown for this response path?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but selecting a new request envelope and expanding a shared plugin contract are compatibility choices that source inspection and green checks cannot determine for all supported BYOK providers.

options.title: Approve the current envelope
options.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the supported Copilot BYOK proxy envelope and approve the backward-compatible destroyOnError helper option.

options.title: Recalibrate before merge
options.body: Choose provider-informed limit and timeout values or keep the teardown behavior private to the Copilot plugin before landing the fix.

recommendation.title: Approve the current envelope
recommendation.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the supported Copilot BYOK proxy envelope and approve the backward-compatible destroyOnError helper option.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged BYOK parity work introduced and calibrated the proxy's provider and runtime boundary.
